messages:
emma: Auditor request arrived: they want a concise evidence packet for the RBAC adjustment we did on service-account-retrieval-prod (reducing scope) and the linked KMS decrypts for 2025-06-18 11:00-12:00 UTC. Deliverable: single PDF runbook + signed KMS audit export.
jorge: Change tracked in JIRA SEC-2034; PR is infra/iam#1378, commit 7f2b3c. The change replaced broad role with a minimal bespoke role (kms.decrypt + logs.read).
priya: I can pull the kube-audit event and the gitops deploy timeline. Suggest we include a brief least-privilege checklist we used (owner, justification, access matrix).
secbot: evidence-collector: started job ev-20250618-003; collecting: jira/SEC-2034, commit/7f2b3c, kube-audit-snippet, kms-audit-export. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_maya: Clarify: 1) auditor needs signed export with checksum; 2) proof that the new role was reviewed (matrix or checklist); 3) retention confirmation and statement on immutability/worm. They also asked to map artifacts to SOC2 CC-3.2 and CC-6.1, and ISO A.9.4.
ops-ryan: I'll export the KMS decrypt logs for the hour window using gcloud and sign with our ops GPG key. I'll also notarize the SHA512 in our timestamping service. Commands I'll run: 
```bash
# export decrypt events
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND timestamp>="2025-06-18T11:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2025-06-18T12:00:00Z"' --format=json > /tmp/kms-20250618.json
# compute checksum and sign
sha512sum /tmp/kms-20250618.json > /tmp/kms-20250618.json.sha512
gpg --local-user ops@redwood.com --output /tmp/kms-20250618.json.sig --detach-sign /tmp/kms-20250618.json
# notarize hash (internal service)
notaryctl timestamp --artifact /tmp/kms-20250618.json.sha512 --key ops-notary-key --output /tmp/kms-20250618.notary
# upload to evidence bucket
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250618.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-06-18/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250618.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-06-18/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250618.json.sha512 s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-06-18/
aws s3 cp /tmp/kms-20250618.notary s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-06-18/
```
priya: Splunk check for KMS lines (sanitized): 
```splunk
index=cloud_audit protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\" resource.labels.kms_key_id=\"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-key\" earliest=06/18/2025:11:00:00 latest=06/18/2025:12:00:00 | table _time, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request.hash
```
jorge: The least-privilege checklist is at /docs/security/rbac-checks/2025-06-17-retrieval-sa.md 50% reduction in granted permissions noted. I'll extract the summary paragraph into the runbook.
secbot: evidence-collector: progress 2/4 (jira/SEC-2034, commit/7f2b3c added).
auditor_maya: Can you include: a) the chain-of-custody (who ran the export and when), b) signature fingerprint and notary timestamp, c) mapping table to controls?
emma: I'll draft a one-page runbook: timeline, artifacts with short descriptions, signature fingerprints, SHA512 value and notarization reference, plus a 1-row control matrix mapping SEC-2034 -> CC-3.2/CC-6.1/ISO A.9.4. Will upload PDF to drive and add presigned S3 link.
ops-ryan: Export signed and notarized. Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-06-18/kms-20250618.json (signature + sha512 + notary). SHA512: 9f2c4b8d... (notarized). GPG key fingerprint: 0x7F3A9C1B. Notary ticket: NT-20250618-77.
secbot: evidence-collector: progress 4/4. job ev-20250618-003 status=success artifacts=4
auditor_maya: Received notification. Please send presigned link to the bundle + the one-pager. Auditor will validate the notarized hash against the sample lines. They may request 4 raw lines for validation.
jorge: Done. Drive runbook: https://drive.redwood/internal/evidence/1775009999-runbook.pdf. Presigned bundle: https://presigned.s3.redwood/evidence/2025-06-18/bundle-1775009999.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800
emma: Closing checklist: follow-up retro in SEC-2040 to tighten approval wording for emergency/quick changes. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
